notes.title: Development Release #33
notes.notes:
This release includes many fixes and a couple of bigger items:

- Repository: On the title screen, you can now see all the cards in the game. However, some of them have yet to be discovered!
- Custom game seed: Before you start a new run, you can customize the game seed to whatever you'd like (currently this is limited to 8 characters, however this might go away).
- Fix shop: The shop didn't contain any cards to buy! Now, there's cards in it. We haven't fully decided how those cards are picked, but at least you can buy some.
- Event log: During a fight, there's now an Event Log that contains all the things that are happening during a fight. This should make it easier to follow and understand what's going on in a fight.
- Deadshot card fix: Deadshot can now be cancelled and played again. Thanks, Robin.

Generally, this release contains a lot of new features that need to be ironed out in the coming releases.

notes.title: Development Release #32: Fixes!
notes.notes:
This upgrade fixes things we have broken in the recent release, LOL!
Namely, both the cargo screen and the ship upgrades have been fixed.

LES GO.

notes.title: Development Release #31: Internals
notes.notes:
Another release that doesn't contain any visible progress whatsoever, but was still needed.
Onwards!

notes.title: Development Release #30: Steam cloud
notes.notes:
This release brings steam cloud to the settings.
I.e., no matter where you play (certain) settings are stored in the cloud.

Slow and steady, let's go!

notes.title: Development Release #29: More maintenance!
notes.notes:
Trying to keep up with some sort of release cadence,
this one includes an updated version of the FMOD bindings and a setting to disable screen shake.

notes.title: Release 28: Maintenance!
notes.notes: This release is all about internals. Lot's of things have been refactored to be easier to manage long-term.

notes.title: Memory game!
notes.notes:
This update brings the first minigame as one of the possible random encounters!
It also adds weird new cards that won't be in the final game - for testing purposes.
Along with the memory game, this release includes numerous bug fixes.
Most notably, the game should launch much quicker than in previous releases.

Thanks to all our playtesters for providing valuable feedback.
Don't stop!!1! <3

notes.title: Fixes, nothing but fixes.
notes.notes:
This update focuses on fixes, not features:

[list]
[*] Boosters can now only be enabled during the player's turn.
[*] Set HP of Matriarch enemy to 122/122.
[*] Show a popup if the settings couldn't be loaded succesfully.
[*] Fix card hover sound not always playing during a fight.
[*] Fix gigantic bug where certain cards have been basically played twice (e.g.: Combust).
[*] Fix another gigantic bug in damage calculations. If the enemy had shields that were higher than the damage being dealt, all of the shields got removed. Urghs.
[*] No longer show a red background in health bars. This has been broken for quite a while and will be re-added when the visuals of the game are getting more clear.
[*] Show card type on each card.
[/list]

Thanks to all the playtesters! <3 uwu

notes.title: Boosters!
notes.notes: Along with a couple of internal changes, this upgrade brings boosters! Yay :D

notes.title: Ship Upgrades!
notes.notes:
This update brings ship upgrades! Yay :D

It also includes a fix to a gigantic bug regarding current/max health where the
player was able to over-heal.

notes.title: Cargo :-)
notes.notes:
This release brings several improvements, but most notably a new map node: Cargo!
Cargo nodes are basically rewards you can find on the map, plus bosses also drop them!

Alongside that, there's a lot of internal reworking going on:

[list]
[*] Better map layouting
[*] Reduced the number of autoloaded scripts which should improve the initial loading time
[*] Fight rewards now contain random cards based on a weighted probably: That means that common cards are most likely to be rewarded and rare cards the least. This weighting changes based on the fight. If you beat a boss, all cards will be rare!
[/list]

notes.title: A prettier Map
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add a legend to the map.
[*] Switch map generation algorithm to one that is more tweakable.
[*] Animate lines between the map node the player is on and the ones the player can travel towards.
[*] Color visited map nodes and lines in pink.
[/list]

notes.title: Better UX!
notes.notes:
This release focuses on improving the UX, hopefully making the game easier to play:

[list]
[*] Highlight "End turn" button when no cards can be played.
[*] Fight rewards: Gold is now collected automatically.
[*] Fight rewards: Removed confirmation of empty screen.
[*] No longer show the "Discard a card" prompt when you have no cards to discard!
[*] Add tooltips to the most important elements on the fight screen. 
[/list]

Thank to all my playtesters!

notes.title: Gameplay fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Completely reworked the damage system.
[*] Fixed combust: It now reduces the players health by 1 correctly. That is, it's ignoring effects on the player.
[*] The damage on cards now show whether they are affected by Buffs/Debuffs or not by highlighting their damage value in bright green. This is for hand cards only.
[*] Buffs/Debuffs should decay correctly now. Note that some Buffs/Debuffs don't decay.
[*] Technical: Upgraded to Godot 4.1.2.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest fixes, Round 2!
notes.notes:
This update includes fixes we have identified with the help of our playtesters:

[list]
[*] Character effects on enemies are no longer shared between them. Thanks, Nathir.
[*] Remove background icon from feedback button. It was hard to read.
[*] Unified styling of the UI, starting with buttons.
[*] Upgrade to FMOD for Godot 4.1.1.
[*] Added a persistent feedback button the left edge of the screen.
[*] You can no longer "click through" the card grid onto the map. Thanks Victor.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest fixes!
notes.notes:
This release includes fixes brought to our attention by our playtesters!

[list]
[*] Clicking on the boss on the map starts the boss fight
[*] The settings can now be accessed from the pause menu
[*] Audio settings are now probably restored when first launching the game
[*] Toggling pause using the "Resume" button properly works now
[*] Beginnings of UI unification: Buttons should all look more coherent now
[/list]

This is still early in development. Thanks to everyone who tested and continues
to help us make the game better.

notes.title: Pretty Settings
notes.notes: In this release, we have overhauled the settings screen. It should be much easier to see the separate elements and apply them.

notes.title: Better audio using FMOD
notes.notes:
This update brings FMOD integration!
That hopefully means a smoother audio workflow going forward.
We also added separate sliders to change the audio levels for master, music, ui, and sfx channels.

And a non-audio-related update as well:
The window size and position are now saved between game launches.

notes.title: Persisted settings
notes.notes:
This update brings persisted settings! The settings you change in the game will be persisted on your local hard drive, just like you'd expect.
We plan to eventually store settings on Steam instead, but first things first. Also, the game is no longer pause-able on the title or ending screen, because that just doesn't make sense.

notes.title: Fullscreen mode can be switched off
notes.notes:
Added an option to disable fullscreen mode to the settings screen.

There's a known issue when you switch from fullscreen to windowed mode: The mouse pointer of the operationg system will be displayed until the game window loses and regains focus. This is a bug in Godot.

notes.title: Fix card upgrades
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes card upgrades. They weren't working at all. Thanks Cajun.
[*] Map: Limit vertical camera movement. You can no longer scroll "off the map". Thanks Cajun. 
[/list]

notes.title: A simple ending
notes.notes:
This update adds a first boss fight! When won it will lead the player to the ending screen,
which also contains the feedback form. Since this is still an MVP and is
only seen by play-testers, this seemed like a good place to ask for feedback.

notes.title: The first power card
notes.notes:
This build contains the first power card, for now named "Combust". You can retrieve it as a reward after winning a fight!

A power is a permanent upgrade for the entire combat encounter. Some Powers give flat stats like Accuracy. Some powers require certain conditions to be met that combat. Some powers provide a unique Buff that can potentially alter the play style. Each copy of a given power can only be played once per combat.

notes.title: Fix card UI state
notes.notes:
This build should fix card UI states and how they interact in your hand vs. if you look at a grid of cards.
The underlying system of this is still in flux and will most likely change.

notes.title: Download size optimization
notes.notes: With this change, the download size will be much smaller than it used to be. It should be around 50% less files!

notes.title: Added a loading screen
notes.notes:
With this update, we're adding a loading screen to the game. Yep, wow!
The game takes a bit to load and that felt like there was something wrong.
Now, it should open up much quicker while all the assets are being loaded in the background.

notes.title: Better scrolling behaviour on the map
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] When opening the map screen for the first time, the view will now start at the boss (at the very top)
and slowly scroll down towards the player. This should give the player the possibily to have a quick glance of the map. After the scroll, the player can use their mouse to scroll (either mouse wheel or drag).
[*] After each fight, the game switches back to the map. Now, the camera follows the player ship so you don't have to search where it is. Thanks to Jamal Pennant for the suggestion!
[/olist]

notes.title: Player energy fixes
notes.notes: Fixed a problem where the player was able to play cards even though they didn't have enough energy.

notes.title: In-game feedback
notes.notes: There's now a feedback button in the pause menu that opens a feedback form that you can use to send us input. The feedback is sent right to our discord server.

notes.title: Image optimizations
notes.notes:
- Optimized all images
- Removed unused big assets
- Enabled MSAA 8x

notes.title: Pausing & quitting
notes.notes: Can now pause and quit the game. Wow!
